_readme: A worked example showing every line shape. Copy this file, edit it, run the generator against it. Every field except `lines` is optional. `status` is "proforma" (the default — an order that is not confirmed yet) or "invoice" (a confirmed sale). The two run separate number sequences.

lines.description: Mixed vintage — sorted, by the kilo

notes: Two pallets, booked for Wednesday. Shortages to be reported within 48 hours of delivery.
